conflict.title: Retry within a budget
conflict.name: app

options.title: Keep both changes
options.detail: Commits the person's files in the clone on the new branch edits/wo-1-7130cd7a239a, leaving the clone's checkout, index, and files as they are, then asks the lane to merge that branch and keep both changes.
commands: git branch edits/wo-1-7130cd7a239a "$(git commit-tree "$(git write-tree)" -p HEAD -m 'Commit files from a clone that ropeshift could not read')"

ropeshift message send lane-wo-1 --project default --kind instruction --body 'A person changed docs/guide.md, plans/plan.md too. Merge the branch edits/wo-1-7130cd7a239a into your branch in your own worktree: it holds their files. Merge origin/main into your branch: it holds the commits they pushed. Keep both changes: overwrite neither side, and ask when they cannot both stand.'

options.title: Keep the person's side
options.detail: Asks the lane to revert its branch's change to these files and keep the rest of its work, so the person's change stands.
commands: ropeshift message send lane-wo-1 --project default --kind instruction --body 'A person changed docs/guide.md, plans/plan.md too. Keep their change: revert your branch'\''s change to docs/guide.md, plans/plan.md, and keep the rest of your work.'

options.title: Stop the lane's work
options.detail: Cancels the work order, so its branch merges nowhere and the person's change stands. The branch stays.
commands: ropeshift work cancel wo-1 --project default --reason 'A person changed the same files: docs/guide.md, plans/plan.md.'

conflict.clears: This clears when the lane's branch holds edits/wo-1-7130cd7a239a and the commits of origin/main that changed these files, or no longer changes them, or when the lane's work is merged or stopped.
